title: Slovakian Braised Pork Chops with Pineapple
description: A hearty Slovakian-inspired dish featuring tender braised pork chops served with a sweet and tangy pineapple sauce.
instructions: Season the pork chops with salt and black pepper.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the pork chops until browned on both sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the pork chops from the skillet and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add more olive oil if necessary. Add the sliced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the Slovakian braised and pineapple to the skillet, stirring to combine.
Return the pork chops to the skillet and simmer for 10-15 minutes or until cooked through.
Serve the pork chops with the pineapple sauce spooned over the top.
